entry_level_pmet.definition: Vacancies suitable for fresh graduates, advertised to recruit local job seekers, with a minimum monthly salary from SGD 2,300 to SGD 5,000; sources include MOM surveys and online job portals.
entry_level_pmet.source_boundary: This measure uses a different source and denominator from the employer vacancy survey.

named_hard_to_fill_pmet_jobs: Software, web, multimedia and games developers and designers
limitations: Industry figures are contextual and must not be assigned to every occupation in an industry.
Named jobs are examples from the report, not complete detailed-SSOC vacancy counts.
The entry-level PMET measure has a different source and denominator from the employer vacancy survey.

ai_adoption_2026.title: Inaugural Release of Report on Adoption of Artificial Intelligence Among Firms
ai_adoption_2026.scope: Private sector establishments with at least 10 employees.
ai_adoption_2026.notes: MOM reports AI adoption remains early and uneven, with no indication of significant job displacement at this point. The metrics are used as contextual adoption evidence, not as occupation-level realised displacement data.

labour_market_q1_2026_detailed.title: Labour Market Report 1Q 2026
labour_market_q1_2026_detailed.limitation: National and broad labour-market context only. These values cannot be assigned to detailed occupations or attributed causally to AI.

source.title: Labour Force in Singapore 2025, advance release

early_career_2025.population: Singapore residents aged 15 to 29 with previous work experience
early_career_2025.classification: Unemployed residents are classified by their previous occupation as PMET or non-PMET.
limitations: Excludes unemployed residents without work experience, including many never-employed fresh entrants.
The denominator is employed residents plus unemployed residents who previously worked in the occupation class.
These are not total youth-unemployment rates and do not identify an AI effect.

labour_market_q2_2026_advance.title: Labour Market Advance Release 2Q 2026
labour_market_q2_2026_advance.limitation: Advance macro figures only. Q1 2026 remains the latest detailed occupation-group release until the full Q2 report.

postings_monitor.limitation: The sample is not representative of Singapore hiring and contains no recent posting volume; it cannot rank current demand.
